text: {"differences": [{"reason": "English mentions \"OCOFA\" and \"Federal Administration personnel pool\" while French uses \"OCAF\" and \"pool de personnel de l’administration fédérale\".", "type": "meaning_shift", "en": {"quote": "OCOFA has created the legal basis for federal employees to be deployed temporarily for Federal Administration crisis management when necessary (‘Federal Administration personnel pool’)", "before": "Furthermore,"}, "tgt": {"quote": "l’OCAF pose les fondements juridiques pour l’engagement de personnel auxiliaire (pool de personnel de l’administration fédérale)", "before": "Par ailleurs,"}, "severity": 0.8}, {"reason": "English refers to \"The Organisation for Crisis Management\" website providing two online training modules, while French states the modules are on the \"OBGC\" (Organisation de base de gestion de crise) website.", "type": "meaning_shift", "en": {"quote": "The Organisation for Crisis Management website provides two online training modules on crisis management in the Federal Administration.", "before": "The Organisation for Crisis Management website provides two online training modules on crisis management in the Federal Administration."}, "tgt": {"quote": "Les deux modules de formation en ligne sont en libre accès sur le site Internet de l’organisation de base de gestion de crise (OBGC).", "before": "Lien"}, "severity": 0.8}, {"reason": "English includes \"Online learning module of the OCOFA Ordinance\" as a separate item, which has no direct counterpart in the French text.", "type": "omission", "en": {"quote": "Online learning module of the OCOFA Ordinance", "before": "Online learning module of the OCOFA Ordinance"}, "tgt": null, "severity": 0.6}, {"reason": "French includes \"Documents\" as a separate item, which has no direct counterpart in the English text.", "type": "addition", "en": null, "tgt": {"quote": "Documents", "before": "Informations complémentaires"}, "severity": 0.6}]}
